title: Not what I expected...
text: I think when I signed up for the Gainz Box, I expected more I guess.  It isn't anything like I thought it was going to be.  I loved the shirt I received, and I liked the bottle, however the rest of it was just filled with samples.  I think for my first box, it was a bit of a disappointment.  It would have been nice to have a workout card included with the box as well so that you could do the exercise in the gym.  All and all if I had to say what I thought about the box...it was a sample box of stuff you can buy  such as hydration packets, etc.  I will give it two more months, and see how it goes.  Based on this box, I might not renew...
label: neutral
